payload.posture: Read Philippians 4:4–9 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joy, gentleness, prayer, thought, and practiced example. Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!” Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
